note: Points of interest for the Gale boxwork demo area. positionSource says where each position comes from: drill-sites.json / rover waypoint = Curiosity's localized end-of-drive positions (drill holes are within a few metres of the rover), 'illustrative' = a plausible spot picked for the demo from the HiRISE image, not a surveyed target. Keep claims modest.

pois.name: Altadena drill hole
pois.summary: Curiosity's last drill hole before the boxwork campaign, one of the three ~6 cm sample holes in this area.
pois.roverDid: Drilled a ~6 cm deep hole and delivered powder to the rover's onboard instruments.
pois.roverCouldNot: Sample more than a single spot per drill campaign, or look below the drilled depth.
pois.humanCan: Collect a hand sample from the outcrop around the hole for comparison with the boxwork ridges and hollows.

pois.name: Valle de la Luna (hollow)
pois.summary: Drill hole in a hollow between boxwork ridges. Analyses pointed to carbonate in the hollow-floor rock.
pois.roverDid: Drilled a ~6 cm hole in the hollow floor as the 'low' half of a ridge/hollow pair.
pois.roverCouldNot: Dig through the sand that fills most hollows, so bedrock under the sand stays unsampled; wheels slipped in the sand-filled hollows.
pois.humanCan: Trench through the hollow-fill sand with a scoop to reach bedrock and see how the carbonate is distributed.

pois.name: Nevado Sajama (ridge top)
pois.summary: Drill hole on a boxwork ridge top, about 20 m from Valle de la Luna. The ridge rock contained clay minerals.
pois.roverDid: Drilled a ~6 cm hole on the ridge crest as the 'high' half of the ridge/hollow pair.
pois.roverCouldNot: Sample the ridge walls or the central fracture that the groundwater is thought to have followed.
pois.humanCan: Sample the ridge wall from top to base and look at the fracture fill in cross-section.

pois.name: Unsampled ridge intersection
pois.summary: A junction where several boxwork ridges meet. Junctions may show where fractures crossed and which groundwater pulse came first.
pois.roverDid: Imaged boxwork ridges from a distance.
pois.roverCouldNot: Climb onto narrow ridge crests or reach the junction without risking the wheels.
pois.humanCan: Walk the junction, photograph cross-cutting relations and take samples from each ridge arm.

pois.name: Sand-filled hollow: dig to bedrock
pois.summary: A broad hollow covered by wind-blown sand. What lies under the sand is one of the open questions of the campaign.
pois.roverDid: Avoided sand-filled hollows after wheel slip.
pois.roverCouldNot: Excavate more than a shallow wheel scuff.
pois.humanCan: Dig a hand trench through the sand to the hollow floor and sample it.

pois.name: Edge of the boxwork network
pois.summary: Where the ridge network fades into the surrounding layered rock. Tracing the edge shows how far the groundwater system reached.
pois.roverDid: Mapped the network mostly from orbit and from its drive path.
pois.roverCouldNot: Leave its planned path to trace the network boundary.
pois.humanCan: Walk the boundary and record where ridges stop, with samples on each side.

pois.name: Ridge overlook
pois.summary: A slightly higher spot with a view across the boxwork, useful for orienting a crew before entering the hollows.
pois.roverDid: Took context panoramas from nearby stops.
pois.roverCouldNot: Reposition freely for the best viewpoint.
pois.humanCan: Take a panorama and choose the safest line into the network.

pois.name: Start: boxwork camp (sol 4820)
pois.summary: An end-of-drive spot on Curiosity's track about 170 m east of the drill sites (rover tilt under 4°).
pois.roverDid: Stopped here on sol 4820 after the drill campaign.
pois.humanCan: Start and end the EVA here: the rover already drove on this ground.

pois.name: Start: north rover stop (sol 4571)
pois.summary: An end-of-drive spot on Curiosity's track north of the boxwork, where the rover sat at a low 2° tilt.
pois.roverDid: Stopped here on sol 4571 on its way south into the boxwork.
pois.humanCan: Start and end the EVA here: the rover already drove on this ground.

pois.name: Start: south rover stop (sol 4851)
pois.summary: An end-of-drive spot on Curiosity's track south of the boxwork band.
pois.roverDid: Stopped here on sol 4851 heading south.
pois.humanCan: Start and end the EVA here: the rover already drove on this ground.
